speaker_mark.description: The design mark, 1 m on axis, taken twice.
speaker_mark.use_when: Use by default: the speaker fit and its trials need only the mark.

baseline_full.description: Thirteen poses 1 m out: on axis four times, every 10 degrees to 40 degrees left and right, and 10 and 20 degrees up and down.
baseline_full.use_when: Use when a crossover decision needs the full listening window.

baseline_express.description: Five poses 1 m out: on axis four times, 20 degrees left and right, and 10 degrees up and down.
baseline_express.use_when: Use when one speaker round should collect driver fits, repeats and off-axis evidence together.

tournament_express.description: The design mark, 1 m on axis, taken once.
tournament_express.use_when: Use to compare candidates at one spot.

tournament_full.description: Three poses 1 m out: on axis and 20 degrees left and right.
tournament_full.use_when: Use to compare candidates across the listening window.

seat_cube.description: Seven seat poses: the head centre and 30 cm to each side of it along the right, forward and up axes.
seat_cube.use_when: Use when three seats give too noisy a room average.

seat_cloud.description: Eleven seat poses: a 3 by 3 grid 30 cm apart around the head centre, plus 30 cm above and below it.
seat_cloud.use_when: Use for the widest listening-area average.

seat_express.description: Three seat poses held by hand: the head centre, 30 cm right of it and 30 cm forward of it.
seat_express.use_when: Use for room, bass and rear takes at the listening seat by hand.

bass_axis.description: The design mark, 1 m on axis, placed by the arm.
bass_axis.use_when: Use for bass takes on the arm.

room_quick.description: Three arm bearings 1 m out: on axis and 20 degrees left and right.
room_quick.use_when: Use for quick arm smoke tests; these poses are not the listening seat.

rear_express.description: Three poses 1 m out: on axis twice, and 20 degrees left and right.
rear_express.use_when: Use for rear takes in front of the speaker that the arm can reach.

rear_wide.description: Five poses 1 m out: on axis twice, and 20 and 45 degrees left and right.
rear_wide.use_when: Use when the rear stage's effect matters further off axis.

nearfield_woofer.description: The woofer at 15 mm and then 30 mm from its dust cap, held by hand.
nearfield_woofer.use_when: Use for near-field woofer takes; each declared woofer output plays in turn.

drivers_each.description: The design mark, 1 m on axis, once for the woofer role and once for the tweeter.
drivers_each.use_when: Use to take each driver alone without moving the microphone.

rear_behind.description: Two poses held by hand: 1 m in front of the cabinet, then behind it, halfway to the wall.
rear_behind.use_when: Use to read the cardioid null toward the wall, which the arm cannot reach.

poses.headline: Place the microphone in front of the speaker
poses.detail: One metre in front of the cabinet, at woofer height, pointed at the front baffle. Keep it still for all passes.

poses.headline: Place the microphone behind the speaker
poses.detail: Halfway between the back of the cabinet and the wall, at woofer height, pointed at the back of the cabinet. Keep it still for all passes.

presets.description: The level check and the timing take, then each driver alone at each pose, plus one summed sweep per pose kept as room evidence.
presets.use_when: Use to linearize each driver and set the crossover, and to trial a speaker document with candidates.

presets.description: The level check and the timing take, then each driver alone once per pose; with candidates, each candidate summed at each pose.
presets.use_when: Use to compare two or three speaker candidates side by side.

presets.description: Each driver's branch of one saved candidate, on one clock, at the mark.
presets.use_when: Use for a branch diagnostic round before a driver or blend preview; name the candidate with candidates.

presets.description: The front and rear woofer branches of one saved candidate, as that candidate plays them, on one clock at the mark.
presets.use_when: Use on a cardioid speaker to read the woofer pair through a candidate's own rear stage; name the candidate with candidates.

presets.description: The whole speaker summed at each pose, through the applied tune or each named candidate.
presets.use_when: Use to trial rear documents with candidates at bearings, or in front of and behind the cabinet with rear_behind.

presets.description: The whole speaker summed at the seat poses, read by both the rear and the room views.
presets.use_when: Use for the hand rear trial: compare rear candidates at the seats, then fit room from the chosen set.

presets.description: The front and rear woofers each alone, on one clock at each pose, through the applied tune or one named candidate with its rear stage cleared.
presets.use_when: Use on a cardioid speaker to bank the pair model that rear previews fit from.

presets.description: The whole speaker summed at the listening seat poses, through the applied tune or each named candidate.
presets.use_when: Use to fit or trial room correction, and again after any upstream change.

presets.description: A bass sweep up to 1.1 kHz, summed at a ladder of levels from the seat reference down, with room correction off, and with the applied bass extension off too when no candidate is named.
presets.use_when: Use to fit or trial bass extension; by hand, pick seat_express.

presets.description: Each declared woofer output alone, close to its dust cap, as reference evidence.
presets.use_when: Use for near-field woofer references; no tuning program reads them yet.

presets.description: Each declared driver output alone at the mark at its own level, with no level check or timing take.
presets.use_when: Use for gated one-driver references at the mark; narrow it to one output with driver.
